messages.author: a3971c23e861221c
messages.subject: URL Launch Failure - Runs Fine Locally
parts:
Hello!

I am trying to learn how to use Shiny and wanted to replicate the example given on the main website. The app works fine locally but it doesn't work in the deployment URL, which is https://gracechang.shinyapps.io/zzzz/ . The app works fine if I do the graph adjustments on the left but crashes if I try to hover over the points. I don't see any other error besides the grayed out screen. I uploaded the original shiny app here: http://gracechang.shinyapps.io/movies-test/ and it seems to work if I hover over the points. I have attached the data and the code that I have used (along with the code that I downloaded from the Shiny gallery). 

Can someone please help point me in the right direction? Or a way that I can look for the problem?

Thank you!

Best,
Grace

Hello again!

I tried to address possible memory issues by re-configuring the app to have 4098 MB memory (overkill, but I just wanted to make sure....) but unfortunately, I still run into the same issue where hovering over the points yields an app crash. 

Both my server.r and ui.r are under 100 lines each, and my data file is just 23KB so I suspect that the issue might not be memory based because my code and my data are not particularly complex. I have also included a .csv file to give easier access to the data that I am using (in case a .db file is inconvenient).

Again, I really appreciate the help and suggestions that other have given and would really welcome other directions that I could explore!

Thank you!

Best,
Grace

What version of ggvis do you have installed?
  packageVersion("ggvis")

You might need to update to version 0.3.0.1. There was an issue with version 0.3 that might be the culprit here.

-Winston
